verdict.rationale: The SDK documents downloading models with detailed progress events (docs-30, docs-9), the CLI runs small local models offline (docs-6), and the docs index advertises open models (probe-1). Nothing in the evidence says models can be pulled directly from Hugging Face or that arbitrary user-chosen repos are supported. missing for 10: explicit Hugging Face repo/URL download support, documentation on which model formats and arbitrary open models can be loaded, hands-on corroboration of downloading and running a Hugging Face model.
